On Board with Orbus newsletter

Sign up to our online newsletter to keep up to date on news and information about the Orbus service and Bee Card in Dunedin and Queenstown.

The newsletter is sent out when there are announcements, changes to the network or other items of interest, rather than on a set frequency.
